verdict.rationale: Fathom has a public pricing page listing feature bullets such as unlimited recordings and transcriptions, AI summaries, CRM sync, coaching scorecards and SSO/SCIM, and the developer FAQ confirms multiple plans exist ('included on all plans'). However, the evidence never shows a free tier by name, any dollar prices, or which features map to which tier. missing for 10: explicit free-tier evidence, per-tier price amounts, a clear tier-by-tier feature mapping, confirmation that no tier requires 'talk to sales'.
